# Upstream Runtime Attribution and Fork Boundary

This directory preserves the third-party notices for a modified source
dependency integrated into ArenaForge.

- Upstream project: Arbor
- Upstream repository: `https://github.com/RUC-NLPIR/Arbor`
- Inspected revision: `65ffcc8fdf23a64a781940e6a3cfb6369d6d887e`
- License: Apache-2.0

The integrated runtime is located at
`src/arenaforge/research_runtime/`. ArenaForge-specific code adds research
contracts, campaigns, evidence records, a hash-chained ledger, scoped
certificates, local/SSH execution, and delivery export.
